player_prompt.intro: Kuna wasa {color} a cikin wasan Breakthrough. Kuna motsa {direction} a kan {board_size}x{board_size} jirgi. A lokacin da za ku iya motsawa guda ɗaya mataki daya gaba ko kuma a gaba. Za a iya motsawa ta hanyar diagonal idan wani abokin gaba ya kasance a can, kuma kawai ya motsa zuwa cikin irin wannan filin da aka damu a cikin wani mataki na diagonal. Lokacin shiga cikin filin tare da abokin gaba, za ku kama shi kuma an cire ɓangaren abokin gaba daga cikin jirgi. Yi amfani da bayanin UCI a cikin ƙuƙwalwa, misali [a2a3] don motsawa daga a2 zuwa a3. * 'a' ya dace da shafi na hagu, '1' shine layin ƙasa (daga hangen nesa na White). * Gidan gida na Black shine layin sama (layin 8 don 8x8). Gidan gida na White shine layin ƙasa (layin 1 don 8x8). Idan dan wasan da ya fara zuwa gidan abokin gaba ya lashe duk abubuwan da aka kama, za ku rasa.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Da fatan za a yi amfani da alamun algebraic na bracketed kamar [a2a3].
invalid_move.illegal: Wannan motsi ba ya bin ka'idojin Breakthrough ko kuma ba kayan aikinka ba ne.

outcome.white_reached: White ya kai gidan gidan Black.
outcome.black_reached: Black ya kai gidan gidan White.
outcome.no_moves: Mai kunnawa {player_id} ba shi da ƙarin motsawa.
